title: Estimated health and economic cost of Global Lead Pollution
notes: Lead exposure is one of the most urgent yet overlooked development challenges of our time. title: Investing in Nutrition: Key to a More Productive Guatemala
notes: In Guatemala, 46% of children under the age of two suffer from chronic malnutrition. This means that nearly half of Guatemalan children have their physical, cognitive, and economic futures compromised even before starting school. This reality places the country among those most affected by malnutrition worldwide. Overcoming this situation requires comprehensive interventions starting from pregnancy and continuing through the first years of life. Adequate nutrition and access to safe water improve learning potential, school retention, and the likelihood of obtaining decent employment in adulthood. These are fundamental to building a healthy and productive human capital base that drives Guatemala’s development.
